## POST `/api/2.29/user-group-quota-policies`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a new user-group-quota policy for file systems. To import existing purequota and purefs configured quotas to a new policy, the file_system_names or file_system_ids parameter is required, but they cannot be set together. To create a policy from scratch, policy body is required.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `names` | query | array of string | yes | A comma-separated list of resource names. |

**Request body** (required): `UserGroupQuotaPolicyPost`

|---|---|---|

| `name` | string | A user-specified name. The name must be locally unique and can be changed. |
| `realms` | array of `_fixedReference` (read-only) | Reference to the realms this resource belongs to. The value is set to empty array when the resource lives outside of a realm. |

| `location` | `_fixedReference` | Reference to the array where the policy is defined. |

| `rules` | array of `UserGroupQuotaPolicyRuleInPolicy` | All of the rules that are part of this policy. |

**Request body** (required): `UserGroupQuotaPolicyRulePost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enforced` | boolean | If set to `true`, this rule describes an enforced quota. A quota error is issued if the logical space usage of the subject exceeds the limit value described in this rule. |
| `notifications` | string | Specifies whether to send notifications to the affected quota subject or not. Valid values are `None` and `Account`. Defaults to `Account`. |

| `quota_type` | string | Specifies quota type for the quota policy. Valid values are `user`, `group`, `user-default`and `group-default`. `user-default` and `group-default` cannot be specified with a subject. |
| `subject` | `UserGroupQuotaSubject` | The user or group subject on which this rule is applied |
